name: Veronika Cifrová Ostrihoňová - Après le § 27 - Am 12
title: REPORT on public access to documents – report covering the years 2022 - 2024
part_text: 27a. Notes that the existence of a document within the meaning of Regulation (EC) No 1049/2001 is independent of its registration; stresses that documents relating to EU policies or significant financial commitments cannot be deemed non-existent solely because they were not registered or were categorised as ‘short-lived’, and that any unjustified destruction, non-registration or loss of such documents constitutes a serious breach of the principles of transparency and good administration, as well as of the duties of integrity and loyalty binding EU officials and office-holders under the applicable legal framework;
